headlines.title_en: PBOC Vice Governor Zou Lan attends BRICS Finance Ministers and Central Bank Governors Meeting
headlines.summary_en: From August 12 to 13, 2026, PBOC Deputy Governor Zou Lan attended the first BRICS Finance Ministers and Central Bank Governors meeting of the year in Jaipur, India, where participants discussed global economic development and governance, improving the Contingent Reserve Arrangement, and strengthening BRICS cooperation in cross-border payments, sustainable finance, information security, and fintech.

headlines.title: China’s factory-gate prices growth slows to 3.5% in July amid lower fuel prices
headlines.summary:
China’s factory-gate prices growth slowed in July, as lower domestic fuel prices eased cost pressures triggered by the US-Israel war on Iran, while high temperatures dragged manufacturing.
The producer price index (PPI) rose by 3.5 per cent year on year last month, compared with 4.1 per cent in June, according to data released by the National Bureau of Statistics (NBS) on Sunday.

headlines.summary_zh:

headlines.title: 油价今晚下调了 加满一箱油能少花9元
headlines.summary: 金十数据8月14日讯，从国家发展改革委获悉，今日（8月14日）24时国内成品油调价窗口将开启。据国家发展改革委价格监测中心监测，本轮成品油调价周期内（7月31日24时——8月14日24时），国际油价先抑后扬。8月14日24时起，国内汽、柴油零售限价每吨分别下调230元和220元。全国平均来看，92号汽油、95号汽油和0号柴油每升分别下调0.18元、0.19元、0.19元。本轮成品油零售限价下调确认后，私家车单次加满一箱50L的92号汽油，将少花9元。

headlines.title_en: Oil prices lowered tonight; filling a full tank saves 9 yuan
headlines.summary_en: Jin 10 Data August 14 - According to the National Development and Reform Commission, the domestic refined oil price adjustment window will open at 24:00 today (August 14). Monitoring by the NDRC Price Monitoring Center shows that during this adjustment cycle (July 31 24:00 - August 14 24:00), international oil prices first fell then rose. From 24:00 on August 14, domestic retail price caps for gasoline and diesel will be lowered by 230 yuan and 220 yuan per ton, respectively. On a national average basis, 92-octane gasoline, 95-octane gasoline, and 0-diesel will be reduced by 0.18 yuan, 0.19 yuan, and 0.19 yuan per liter, respectively. After this confirmed reduction, a private car filling a 50-liter tank of 92-octane gasoline will save 9 yuan per fill.

headlines.title_en: A-share market close: Three major indices warmed up in afternoon; ChiNext rose 1.12%, CPO sector strong all day
headlines.summary_en: Jin 10 Data August 14 - The three major A-share indices consolidated today, with the Shanghai Composite Index fluctuating narrowly throughout the day and turning positive at the close, while the ChiNext Index briefly fell after midday before regaining momentum and rising over 1% again. At the close, the Shanghai Composite rose 0.01%, the Shenzhen Component Index rose 0.45%, and the ChiNext Index rose 1.12%; the combined turnover of Shanghai and Shenzhen markets exceeded 2.1 trillion yuan, with over 2,300 stocks rising. On the sector front, electronic chemicals strengthened throughout the day, rare earth permanent magnets and CPO sectors opened high and performed strongly, while power and retail sectors were weak.

headlines.title_en: A-share market close: Shanghai Composite narrowly fluctuated, up 0.01%; electronic chemicals, CPO, and non-metallic materials sectors led gains
headlines.summary_en: China's three major A-share indices rose collectively today. At the close, the Shanghai Composite Index rose 0.01%, the Shenzhen Component Index rose 0.45%, the ChiNext Index rose 1.12%, the Beijing Stock Exchange 50 fell 0.94%, and the STAR 50 Index was flat. Total market turnover was 2.1566 trillion yuan, down 411.4 billion yuan from the previous day, with over 2,900 stocks falling. By sector theme, electronic chemicals, non-metal materials, CPO, components, and optical fiber concepts led gains; film and cinema, power, dairy, baijiu, and retail sectors led losses. On the trading front, electronic chemicals trended higher, with Sinoseal and Haixing Shares hitting the daily limit, and Longchen Technology, Siq New Materials, Guanggang Gases, Zhongju Xin, and Gelinda rising. CPO opened high and advanced, with CIG, China Electronics, Jinge New Materials, and Gongjin Electronics hitting limit-up, while Hengtong Optic-Electric, Zhongfu Circuit, and Changyingtong led gains. headlines.title: 财政部：集成电路企业、工业母机企业发生非货币性资产交换5年内转让所取得资产的 应停止执行分期纳税政策
headlines.summary: 金十数据8月14日讯，财政部发布关于集成电路企业、工业母机企业非货币性资产交换企业所得税政策的公告，其中指出，集成电路企业、工业母机企业在2026年1月1日至2028年12月31日期间发生非货币性资产交换，按规定确认的非货币性资产交换所得，可在不超过5年期限内分期均匀计入相应年度的应纳税所得额，按现行政策规定计算缴纳企业所得税；企业进行非货币性资产交换所发生的损失，不得分期确认。集成电路企业、工业母机企业发生非货币性资产交换5年内转让所取得资产的，应停止执行分期纳税政策，并就分期纳税期内尚未确认的非货币性资产交换所得，在转让该资产当年的企业所得税年度汇算

headlines.title_en: Ministry of Finance: For integrated circuit and industrial machine tool enterprises, if assets acquired through non-monetary asset exchanges are transferred within 5 years, the deferred tax payment policy should be discontinued
headlines.summary_en: Jin 10 Data August 14 - The Ministry of Finance issued a notice on the corporate income tax policy for non-monetary asset exchanges by integrated circuit enterprises and industrial machine tool enterprises. It states that for non-monetary asset exchanges occurring between January 1, 2026, and December 31, 2028, the income recognized from such exchanges per regulations may be evenly included in the taxable income for the corresponding years over a period not exceeding 5 years, with corporate income tax calculated per current policy; losses incurred from non-monetary asset exchanges shall not be recognized in installments. If an integrated circuit enterprise or industrial machine tool enterprise transfers the assets acquired in the non-monetary asset exchange within 5 years, it shall cease the installment tax policy and, for the non-monetary asset exchange income not yet recognized during the installment period, include it in the annual corporate income tax settlement for the year of the asset transfer.
